about.what: Every word on the screens, in English (en) and Nepali (ne). Built from pipeline/words/ by pipeline/export/build_words.py; do not edit by hand.
about.placeholders: Texts may hold {names} in braces: fill them from the field file (the same names in both languages; Nepali digits are Devanagari).

texts.en: Your field's friend.
Let's look at your field together.
We help you think. You decide.
Start
Try our sample field
We picked this field as an example.
texts.ne: हामीले यो खेत उदाहरणका लागि छानेका हौं।

texts.en: Tap the four corners of your field.
Tap a corner again to move it.
Done
We have not looked at this place yet.
texts.ne: हामीले यो ठाउँ अहिलेसम्म हेरेका छैनौं।

texts.en: Try our sample field instead.
Where does your field's water come from?
Is your field flat or on steps?
texts.ne: तपाईंको खेत समथर छ कि गरामा?

water.maps_to: config/fields/<id>.yaml water_source: rain-only, canal, well, irrigated (null = unknown); 'other' maps to irrigated

shape.maps_to: not stored yet; terraces would change rules.yaml curve_numbers (METHOD_NOTES.md item 8)

title.en: We looked at your field from space
title.ne: हामीले अन्तरिक्षबाट तपाईंको खेत हेरेका छौं

texts.en: We think you grow {guess_list}.
Is this right?
We think you grow {first_crop} first.
Then {option_a} or {option_b}.
Which one do you grow?
From space, both look the same.
Yes
No, let me fix it
The ground is bare about {bare_days} days yearly.
texts.ne: वर्षमा करिब {bare_days} दिन जमिन खाली रहन्छ।

texts.en: Uncovered soil can wash away in rain.
Since {year_first}, rains start about {shift_days_abs} days earlier.
texts.ne: {year_first} यता वर्षा करिब {shift_days_abs} दिन चाँडै आउँछ।

texts.en: Since {year_first}, rains start about {shift_days_abs} days later.
texts.ne: {year_first} यता वर्षा करिब {shift_days_abs} दिन ढिलो आउँछ।

texts.en: The rains start about when they used to.
Water stored in this whole area is falling.
texts.ne: यो पूरै क्षेत्रमा जम्मा पानी घट्दै छ।

texts.en: Water stored in this whole area is steady.
texts.ne: यो पूरै क्षेत्रमा जम्मा पानी उस्तै छ।

texts.en: Water stored in this whole area is rising.
texts.ne: यो पूरै क्षेत्रमा जम्मा पानी बढ्दै छ।

texts.en: This trend is clear for the wide area.
texts.ne: ठूलो क्षेत्रका लागि यो चाल स्पष्ट छ।

texts.en: It does not tell about your own well.
This is the whole area, not your well.
texts.ne: यो पूरै क्षेत्रको कुरा हो, तपाईंको इनारको होइन।

texts.en: Your field's twelve months
Nepali and English months don't line up exactly.
texts.ne: नेपाली र अंग्रेजी महिना ठ्याक्कै मिल्दैनन्।

texts.en: We may show too many freezing nights.
texts.ne: हामीले तुषारो धेरै देखाएका हुन सक्छौं।

texts.en: We are less sure about this month.
texts.ne: यो महिनाबारे हामी कम पक्का छौं।

frost.maps_to: diary.months[].frost (risk = nights 0 to 2 C, high = below 0 C)

texts.en: We split your field into {section_count} parts.
Each part has a number.
Tap a part to see it.
From space, nearby parts look the same.
The soil stick tells them apart.
texts.ne: माटो जाँच्ने यन्त्रले तिनको फरक देखाउँछ।

texts.en: Part {section}
How wet: {wetness} out of 100.
How warm the soil is: {temp} degrees.
How sure we are: {sure_pct} out of 100.
Fog means we are not sure yet.
texts.ne: कुहिरोको अर्थ, हामी अझै पक्का छैनौं।

texts.en: A smiling face means all is well.
texts.ne: हाँसेको अनुहारको अर्थ सबै ठीक छ।

status.about: How each part is doing (always with a face and a mark, never colour alone)

texts.en: Push the soil stick into this part.
texts.ne: माटो जाँच्ने यन्त्र यो भागमा गाड्नुहोस्।

texts.en: Hold it still for a moment.
Your reading clears the fog.
Now we are more sure.
Space sees wide. Your stick sees close.
texts.ne: अन्तरिक्षले फराकिलो देख्छ। यन्त्रले नजिकबाट देख्छ।

texts.en: Together they make a better guess.
Watch a soil check we did earlier.
texts.ne: हामीले पहिले गरेको माटो जाँच हेर्नुहोस्।

texts.en: Each basket is one year's harvest.
texts.ne: हरेक डोको एक वर्षको उब्जनी हो।

texts.en: A full basket is this field's best.
texts.ne: भरिएको डोको यो खेतको सबैभन्दा राम्रो उब्जनी हो।

texts.en: A computer copy of your field made these.
texts.ne: तपाईंको खेतको कम्प्युटर नमुनाले यी बनाएको हो।

texts.en: The crop was thirsty on {dry_days} days.
With water when needed, it looks like this.
texts.ne: चाहिएको बेला पानी दिँदा यस्तो हुन्थ्यो।

texts.en: We don't know your water yet.
texts.ne: हामीलाई तपाईंको पानीको स्रोत थाहा छैन।

texts.en: So we show both, side by side.
Play
Pause

flood.en: Too much rain in one day

event_season.about: Which season a drier year comes from, when it is one season only (owner, 2026-11-13)
event_season.maps_to: replay.<plan>[].event_season; only present with event 'drought'. Show it instead of the 'drought' words

texts.ne: तीन विकल्प: के लगाउने, कहिले लगाउने।

More drops, less worry about water.
What matters most to you?
Tips for your field
Nepali and English months don't line up exactly.
texts.ne: नेपाली र अंग्रेजी महिना ठ्याक्कै मिल्दैनन्।

texts.en: Why do some crops help the soil?
texts.ne: केही बालीले माटोलाई किन मद्दत गर्छन्?

texts.en: Try less rain or more heat.
texts.ne: कम पानी वा बढी गर्मी राखेर हेर्नुहोस्।

More heat

texts.en: You know your land best.
texts.ne: आफ्नो जमिन तपाईंलाई नै राम्रो थाहा छ।

texts.en: Talk to a farm advisor before changing.
Try it on one small part first.
texts.ne: पहिले एउटा सानो भागमा मात्र गरेर हेर्नुहोस्।

texts.en: Save this plan
Start again
Made with pictures and numbers from NASA.

say.en: Water that rises into the air from the soil and from plant leaves.
say.ne: माटो र बिरुवाका पातबाट उडेर हावामा जाने पानी।

glossary.basis: FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998) Chapter 1, 'Evapotranspiration process': 'The combination of two separate processes whereby water is lost on the one hand from the soil surface by evaporation and on the other hand from the crop by transpiration is referred to as evapotranspiration (ET).' https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e04.htm (opened 2026-11-12)

say.en: How much wetter or drier the soil is than usual for that time of year.
say.ne: वर्षको त्यो समयमा सामान्यभन्दा माटो कति बढी ओसिलो वा सुक्खा छ भन्ने कुरा।

glossary.basis: Standard meaning: the difference from the usual (long-term average) value for the same time of year; the diary's soil words are terciles of 2001-2025 (CLAUDE.md 'Monthly calendar')

say.en: A greenness score from satellite pictures: the higher it is, the more living green leaves.
say.ne: भू-उपग्रहको तस्बिरबाट निकालिएको हरियालीको अङ्क: जति बढी, उति धेरै हरिया पात।

glossary.basis: NASA Earth Observatory, 'Measuring Vegetation (NDVI & EVI)' (Weier & Herring 2000): 'NDVI is calculated from the visible and near-infrared light reflected by vegetation' and 'no green leaves gives a value close to zero'. https://science.nasa.gov/earth/earth-observatory/measuring-vegetation-ndvi-evi/ (opened 2026-11-12). Our NDVI: HLS and MODIS

say.en: The chance of nights near or below freezing (under 2 °C) that can hurt crops.
say.ne: बालीलाई हानि गर्न सक्ने, २ डिग्रीभन्दा चिसो रात पर्ने सम्भावना।

glossary.basis: CLAUDE.md 'Frost': a frost night is Tmin below 0 C, risk band 0 to 2 C. Shown as bands, never as a count (rules.yaml cold_nights.frost_display_note)

say.en: The field's water account: rain and watering in; plant use, runoff and drainage out.
say.ne: खेतको पानीको हिसाब: वर्षा र सिँचाइ भित्र; बिरुवाको प्रयोग, बहाव र चुहावट बाहिर।

glossary.basis: FAO-56 Chapter 8 root-zone water balance (CLAUDE.md 'Soil-water bucket')

say.en: The day the monsoon rains truly begin, with no long dry break soon after.
say.ne: मनसुनको पानी साँच्चै सुरु भएको दिन, जसपछि छिट्टै लामो सुक्खा हुँदैन।

glossary.basis: CLAUDE.md 'Monsoon onset': from 15 May, the first run of at least 2 wet days totalling 10 mm within 5 days, not followed by a 10-day dry spell in the next 20 days

say.en: Days in a year when the field has almost no green plants, seen from space.
say.ne: अन्तरिक्षबाट हेर्दा खेतमा हरियो बिरुवा लगभग नभएका वर्षका दिनहरू।

glossary.basis: CLAUDE.md 'Bare days': interpolated NDVI below the rules.yaml threshold (start 0.25, to be tuned)

say.en: Growing different crops one after another on the same field, season by season.
say.ne: एउटै खेतमा मौसमअनुसार एकपछि अर्को फरक बाली लगाउने तरिका।

glossary.basis: FAO AGROVOC c_6662: 'Technique of growing alternating species or families of crops in a specific field in a planned pattern or sequence.' (opened 2026-11-12)

say.en: A crop grown mainly to keep the soil covered and healthy between main crops.
say.ne: मुख्य बालीहरूको बीचमा माटो ढाकेर स्वस्थ राख्न लगाइने बाली।

glossary.basis: FAO AGROVOC c_1936 'cover plants': 'Crop grown during fallow periods to protect soil, recycle nutrients and control weeds.' (opened 2026-11-12)

say.en: A machine circling the Earth that sees wide areas at once, but not every detail.
say.ne: पृथ्वी घुम्ने यन्त्र, जसले ठूलो क्षेत्र एकैपटक देख्छ तर हरेक सानो कुरा होइन।

glossary.basis: NASA challenge consideration: how satellite observations differ from ground-based measurements

say.en: A reading taken at one spot on the ground: exact there, but only there.
say.ne: जमिनको एउटै ठाउँमा लिइएको नाप: त्यहाँ ठ्याक्कै, तर त्यहाँ मात्र।

glossary.basis: NASA challenge consideration (as above); our ground readings are the Kathmandu Airport station (GHCN-Daily) and the soil probe

say.en: Mixing space, computer and ground readings so each one fixes the others' weak spots.
say.ne: अन्तरिक्ष, कम्प्युटर र जमिनका नाप मिलाएर एउटाको कमजोरी अर्कोले सच्याउने तरिका।

glossary.basis: CLAUDE.md 'Probe fusion' (scalar Kalman update) and decision A (station correction of POWER temperature)

say.en: Worked out by a computer from physics and other readings, not measured directly.
say.ne: सिधै नापिएको होइन, भौतिक नियम र अरू नापबाट कम्प्युटरले निकालेको।

glossary.basis: Golden rule 8: NASA POWER, SMAP L4 and the twin are labelled model-based. On screens: 'worked out by computer'

say.en: Our computer copy of your field that replays each season's water and crops.
say.ne: हरेक मौसमको पानी र बाली फेरि चलाउने तपाईंको खेतको कम्प्युटर नमुना।

glossary.basis: CLAUDE.md 'What this repo is'

say.en: This year's harvest compared with the best this field could give, never in tonnes.
say.ne: यो खेतले दिन सक्ने सबैभन्दा राम्रो उब्जनीसँग दाँज्दा यस वर्षको उब्जनी, टनमा होइन।

glossary.basis: CLAUDE.md 'Yield as a percentage of potential' (FAO-33) and golden rule 11

say.en: Days when the soil is too dry for the crop to drink freely.
say.ne: माटो यति सुक्खा हुन्छ कि बालीले सजिलै पानी खान नसक्ने दिनहरू।

glossary.basis: CLAUDE.md: a dry day is a day with Ks < 1 during a crop season (FAO-56 eq. 84)

say.en: Water brought to the field by canal, well or pipe, as well as rain.
say.ne: वर्षाबाहेक कुलो, इनार वा पाइपबाट खेतमा ल्याइएको पानी।

glossary.basis: config/fields water_source; every replay runs rain-fed and irrigated (owner, 2026-11-12)

say.en: A crop season whose rain was among the lowest fifth of all seasons since 2001.
say.ne: सन् २००१ यताका सबैभन्दा सुक्खा पाँचौं भागमा पर्ने बाली मौसम।

glossary.basis: rules.yaml events.drought_decile_max (rainfall deciles 1-2; owner-approved 2026-11-12, owner's batch decisions item 17)

say.en: A year whose heaviest rain day was among the heaviest fifth of all years.
say.ne: पाँच वर्षमा एक पटक जति आउने, सबैभन्दा भारी पानी परेको दिन भएको वर्ष।

glossary.basis: rules.yaml events.flood_decile_min (owner's batch decisions item 18, 2026-11-12): the year's wettest crop-season day (ETCCDI Rx1day) in deciles 9-10 of the record's years ('much above normal', Gibbs & Maher 1967 classes). Fixed in advance; never tuned on the known floods

say.en: A small stick pushed into the soil that measures how wet and warm it is.
say.ne: माटो कति ओसिलो र तातो छ भनेर नाप्न माटोमा गाडिने सानो यन्त्र।

glossary.basis: CLAUDE.md 'Probe bridge'

say.en: How far a number could be from the truth; on screen, fog shows it.
say.ne: कुनै अङ्क साँचोभन्दा कति फरक हुन सक्छ; स्क्रिनमा कुहिरोले यो देखाउँछ।

glossary.basis: CLAUDE.md: 'sure' (0 to 1) from the probe fusion; projections are ranges (golden rule 11)

say.en: All water held across a wide area, seen by satellites; not your own well.
say.ne: भू-उपग्रहले नापेको ठूलो क्षेत्रभरिको सबै पानी; तपाईंको आफ्नै इनार होइन।

glossary.basis: rules.yaml groundwater.caveat (owner, 2026-11-12): GRACE/GRACE-FO JPL mascon, about 330 km across

say.en: Soil carried away from the field by rain water or wind.
say.ne: पानी वा हावाले खेतको माटो बगाएर लैजाने क्रिया।

glossary.basis: CLAUDE.md 'Erosion (RUSLE)'

say.en: Rain that flows off the field instead of soaking into the soil.
say.ne: माटोमा नपसी खेतबाट बगेर जाने वर्षाको पानी।

glossary.basis: CLAUDE.md 'Runoff (SCS curve number)'

say.en: A crop like lentil whose root bacteria turn nitrogen from air into plant food.
say.ne: मसुरजस्तो बाली, जसको जराका ब्याक्टेरियाले हावाको नाइट्रोजनलाई बिरुवाको खाना बनाउँछन्।

glossary.basis: crop_explainers.json nitrogen_fixing (FAO 2016, 'Soils and pulses: symbiosis for life', printed p. 43)

say.en: A crop whose roots reach water and food deep in the soil.
say.ne: जरा माटोको गहिराइसम्म पुगेर पानी र खाना लिन सक्ने बाली।

glossary.basis: crop_explainers.json deep_rooting (FAO-56 Table 22; FAO Conservation Agriculture)

say.en: A crop that still gives some harvest when the rains are short.
say.ne: पानी कम पर्दा पनि केही उब्जनी दिने बाली।

glossary.basis: crop_explainers.json drought_tolerant (FAO 2023 International Year of Millets; ICRISAT)

say.en: Pests and diseases that build up when crops of one family follow each other.
say.ne: एउटै परिवारका बाली पालैपालो लगाउँदा बढ्दै जाने कीरा र रोग।

glossary.basis: CLAUDE.md 'Score': pest-cycle breaks (no same crop family back to back); FAO Conservation Agriculture, 'Species diversification' (crop rotation prevents carry-over of crop-specific pests and diseases)

say.en: Rotting roots, leaves and dung in the soil that make it dark and crumbly.
say.ne: माटोलाई कालो र खुकुलो बनाउने कुहिएका जरा, पात र गोबर।

glossary.basis: FAO Conservation Agriculture, 'Soil organic cover' and 'Benefits of CA'; SoilGrids soc (organic carbon)

say.en: Days hotter than nine in ten of this place's usual days.
say.ne: यस ठाउँका सामान्य दस दिनमध्ये नौ दिनभन्दा तातो दिनहरू।

glossary.basis: CLAUDE.md 'Trends': hot days are above the local 90th percentile of Tmax

say.en: The size of the patch of land that one satellite or computer number covers.
say.ne: भू-उपग्रह वा कम्प्युटरको एउटा अङ्कले ढाक्ने जमिनको टुक्राको आकार।

glossary.basis: Golden rule 8: every number carries its source, resolution and years

say.en: A computer picture of possible future weather, given as a range, not a forecast.
say.ne: भविष्यको सम्भावित मौसमको कम्प्युटर अनुमान, दायराका रूपमा, पक्का भविष्यवाणी होइन।

glossary.basis: CLAUDE.md 'Future': NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 delta change, SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5, reported as a range

claims.en: Tiny helpers live in lentil roots.
claims.ne: मसुरको जरामा साना उपयोगी जीव बस्छन्।

source.title: Soils and pulses: symbiosis for life
source.where: printed p. 43 (PDF p. 52), section 2.1 'The role of pulses in nutrient (re)cycling'
source.quote: These plants, in symbiosis with certain types of bacteria are able to convert atmospheric nitrogen (N2) into nitrogen compounds (ammonium) that can be used by plants, while also improving soil fertility (FAO, 2016a). The symbiosis occurs in nodules formed on the plant roots, where the nitrogen-fixing bacteria are hosted

claims.en: They turn air into natural fertilizer.
claims.ne: तिनले हावालाई प्राकृतिक मलमा बदल्छन्।

source.title: World Pulses Day 2024: Shining the spotlight on the vital role of pulses in promoting soil health and nourishing people
source.where: body text, paragraph after the Director-General's quote
source.quote: Pulses improve soil health by hosting helpful bacteria, called rhizobia, in their roots. These bacteria convert nitrogen from the air into fertilizers in the soil.

claims.en: The next crop can use that fertilizer.
claims.ne: अर्को बालीले त्यो मल प्रयोग गर्न सक्छ।

source.title: Soils and pulses: symbiosis for life
source.quote: Provision of nitrogen derived from BNF to the subsequent crops ('nitrogen effect') increases yields especially where subsequent crops receive low or moderate levels of fertiliser.

claims.en: So you may need less bought fertilizer.
claims.ne: त्यसैले किनेको मल कम चाहिन सक्छ।

source.title: Soils and pulses: symbiosis for life
source.quote: By fixing atmospheric nitrogen and solubilizing phosphates, pulses contribute to reducing the need for synthetic fertilizers
source.note: FAO gives no figure for how much less fertilizer the next crop needs, so the text says 'may'.

claims.en: In Nepal, lentil often follows rice.
claims.ne: नेपालमा प्रायः धानपछि मसुर लगाइन्छ।

source.title: Paudel, Devkota, Keil and McDonald, 'Climate and landscape mediate patterns of low lentil productivity in Nepal', PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231377
source.quote: the majority of lentil in Nepal is grown in rice-based cropping system [35,36] and most of the rice varieties grown are medium to long-duration.
source.note: All authors are CIMMYT (a CGIAR centre). The study is about the Terai; no source opened describes rice then lentil in the Kathmandu valley itself.

claims.en: Here, lentil is sown mid-October to mid-November.
claims.ne: यहाँ मसुर अक्टोबरको मध्यदेखि नोभेम्बरको मध्यसम्म छरिन्छ।

source.title: FAO Crop Calendar, Nepal, B. Hill Agro-ecological Zone (lastUpdated 26/02/2021)
source.quote: Lentil (Winter): sowing 15 October to 15 November, harvest 15 February to 15 March, 120-145 days
source.note: Data row as recorded in config/crops.json (lentil calendar), not prose from the page.

claims.en: Rain does not hit covered soil hard.
claims.ne: ढाकिएको माटोमा पानीका थोपाले चोट गर्दैनन्।

source.title: Conservation Agriculture: Soil organic cover
source.quote: Vegetative cover is important in CA for the protection of the soil against the impacts of raindrops; to keep the soil shaded; and maintain the highest possible moisture content.

claims.en: More rain soaks in; less soil washes away.
claims.ne: धेरै पानी माटोमा पस्छ, कम माटो बग्छ।

source.title: Benefits of Conservation Agriculture (CA)
source.quote: Residues on the soil surface reduce the splash-effect of the raindrops, and once the energy of the raindrops has dissipated the drops proceed to the soil without any harmful effect. This results in higher infiltration and reduced runoff, leading to less erosion.

claims.en: Their leftovers make the soil richer.
claims.ne: तिनका बाँकी भागले माटो मलिलो बनाउँछ।

source.title: Conservation Agriculture: Soil organic cover
source.quote: Providing an additional source of organic matter to improve soil structure.

claims.en: They can help keep weeds and pests down.
claims.ne: तिनले झार र कीरा कम गर्न सघाउँछन्।

source.title: Conservation Agriculture: Soil organic cover
source.quote: Can be used to control weeds and pests.

claims.en: Lentil and mustard grow here in winter.
claims.ne: मसुर र तोरी यहाँ जाडोमा हुर्कन्छन्।

source.title: FAO Crop Calendar, Nepal, B. Hill Agro-ecological Zone (lastUpdated 26/02/2021)
source.quote: Lentil (Winter): sowing 15 October to 15 November, harvest 15 February to 15 March; Colza (rapeseed): sowing 15 October to 15 November, harvest 15 March
source.note: Data rows as recorded in config/crops.json. The Hill zone lists rapeseed, which crops.json calls mustard.

claims.en: Deep roots find water lower down.
claims.ne: गहिरो जराले तलको पानी भेट्छ।

source.title: Crop evapotranspiration: guidelines for computing crop water requirements (FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56), Chapter 8
source.quote: TAW is the amount of water that a crop can extract from its root zone, and its magnitude depends on the type of soil and the rooting depth.

claims.en: They bring back food washed deep down.
claims.ne: तल बगेर गएको खाना तिनले फेरि माथि ल्याउँछन्।

source.title: Conservation Agriculture: Species diversification
source.quote: as they root at different soil depths, they are capable of exploring different soil layers for nutrients. Nutrients that have been leached to deeper layers and that are no longer available for the commercial crop, can be 'recycled' by the crops in rotation. This way the rotation crops function as biological pumps.

claims.en: Roots leave channels that let rain in.
claims.ne: जराले बनाएका प्वालबाट पानी माटोमा पस्छ।

source.title: Conservation Agriculture: Species diversification
source.quote: Greater distribution of channels or biopores created by diverse roots (various forms, sizes and depths).
source.note: Partly supported: FAO says diverse roots make channels and (on the 'Soil organic cover' page) that some roots raise percolation; it does not tie this to deep roots alone.

claims.en: Millet roots can reach two metres down.
claims.ne: कोदोको जरा दुई मिटरसम्म पुग्न सक्छ।

source.title: Crop evapotranspiration: guidelines for computing crop water requirements (FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56), Chapter 8
source.quote: TABLE 22. Ranges of maximum effective rooting depth (Zr), and soil water depletion fraction for no stress (p), for common crops ... Millet 1.0-2.0 [m]
source.note: FAO-56 gives 'Millet' as one row; finger millet is assumed to fit it (crops.json).

claims.en: Maize roots go much deeper than potato roots.
claims.ne: मकैको जरा आलुको भन्दा धेरै गहिरो जान्छ।

source.title: Crop evapotranspiration: guidelines for computing crop water requirements (FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56), Chapter 8
source.quote: Maize, Field (grain) (field corn) 1.0-1.7 [m] ... Potato 0.4-0.6 [m]

title.en: Crops that cope with dry spells

claims.en: Millets cope with poor soil and hard weather.
claims.ne: कोदोजस्ता बाली कमजोर माटो र कडा मौसम सहन्छन्।

source.title: International Year of Millets 2023: About
source.where: page text ('They' = millets; the page lists finger millet and names Nepal as a grower)
source.quote: They can thrive on poor soils, resist or tolerate many crop diseases and pests, and are resilient to adverse climatic conditions.

claims.en: Finger millet is known as a hardy crop.
claims.ne: कोदो बलियो, कडा बाली मानिन्छ।

source.title: Finger millet: overview
source.quote: The resilient nature of finger millet makes it particularly well-suited for cultivation in harsh agro-climatic conditions.
source.note: Sources call finger millet resilient and hardy, not the most drought-tolerant millet; the next claim says so.

claims.en: But other millets need a little less water.
claims.ne: तर चिनो, कागुनोलाई यसभन्दा अलि कम पानी चाहिन्छ।

source.title: The World Sorghum and Millet Economies: Facts, Trends and Outlook (FAO and ICRISAT), Annex I
source.quote: has a slightly higher water requirement than most other millets and is found in cooler, elevated regions up to 2000 metres above sea level.
source.note: Honesty caveat kept on purpose. Nepali names two other millets (proso, foxtail): reviewer to check.

claims.en: Hill farmers often plant millet among their maize.
claims.ne: पहाडमा किसानहरू प्रायः मकैबारीमा कोदो रोप्छन्।

source.title: Annual Report 2076/77 (2019/2020), National Seed Science Technology Research Centre, NARC, Khumaltar
source.quote: It is the fourth most important food crop in mid hills and high hills of Nepal and plays a vital role in the livelihood in these areas. ... It is pre-dominantly grown under maize/millet relay system in mid-hills of western, central and eastern regions

claims.en: Several different crops make total loss less likely.
claims.ne: धेरै किसिमका बाली लगाउँदा सबै गुम्ने डर घट्छ।

source.title: FAO's Emergency Activities: Technical Handbook Series, Phase One: Prevention
source.quote: Crop diversification can improve the resilience of farming systems to adverse climatic conditions ... By spreading the risks associated with crop cultivation across a wider range of crops and crop characteristics, the likelihood of total crop failure is reduced.
source.note: FAO frames this as diversification across crops, not rotation specifically.
